name: dbrain
description: Postgres-native organizational knowledge brain. Open-source distribution of the substrate that powers Dent Brain. Forked from gbrain (github.com/garrytan/gbrain) with namespace separation so personal gbrain installs and organizational dbrain installs coexist on the same machine.

scripts.build:all: bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile bin/dbrain-darwin-arm64 src/cli.ts && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile bin/dbrain-linux-x64 src/cli.ts
scripts.postinstall: command -v dbrain >/dev/null 2>&1 && dbrain apply-migrations --yes --non-interactive || echo '[dbrain] postinstall skipped. If installed via bun install -g github:...: run `dbrain doctor` and `dbrain apply-migrations --yes` manually.' 1>&2
